skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts and theories of investment.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Principles of State Management in Investment
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand principles and methods of state management in investment activities.
Analyze macro and micro aspects of sources of investment capital.
Identify conditions for effectively mobilizing investment capital.
Manage investment projects and understand their objectives and tasks.
Develop independent learning skills and accumulate experience to improve professional competence.
Work independently and responsibly, with a sense of discipline and cooperation.
Apply critical thinking to solve problems in the field of investment.
Present findings and conclusions effectively in group presentations.
